Handy Features

Faster, and more visible.

Features that get registration and analysis done in seconds. A ton of actions, all completed on the spot from a single task.

⚡

Quick Registration Bar

Type a single line like “Prepare materials 7/25” and hit Enter to register the task instantly

📄

Duplicate Registration

Opens the form pre-filled with an existing task's content — check it over, then register

🗓

Load Heatmap

Shows load by assignee and week using color intensity. Change the assignee with drag and drop

⏱

Lead Time Analysis

Shows days-to-completion as a histogram, with average lead time by priority listed too

🚧

Kanban WIP Limits

Set a max number of concurrent tasks per column — exceed it, and the column header turns a warning color

☑️

Bulk Actions on All Tasks

Select multiple tasks with checkboxes and change status, assignee, and priority all at once

✏️ Quick Edit

Edit everything at once in a single modal

Change status, assignee, and priority on the spot, right in a modal, without opening Backlog. Start and due dates can be edited at the same time too, and only the fields you changed get updated — no extra API requests.

✅

Change Status

👤

Change Assignee

You can also assign yourself with one click using the “Assign to me” button

📅

Change Due Date

Updates start and due dates in a single request, avoiding validation errors

⏱

Timer Tracking

💬

More you can do, starting from a single task.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage all your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. With 7 display views and a Project Dashboard, everyday task management and tracking team progress become effortless.
